answer: Issue a hard cap of exclusive capability leases each epoch. Each identity may hold only one lease, visualized as a plot that might sit on an island, a tundra grid, or a stone ledge, and must lock a slashable deposit against it. Rewards pay only to the current leaseholder. Because two keys cannot share a lease, a farm of N fakes has to win N separate auctions and keep N deposits locked for the whole epoch, so attacker cost follows the market price of scarce plots rather than the near-zero cost of minting keys.
